name: Perihelion Gait-Tuned Running Shoe
description:
Perihelion builds each shoe around a full biomechanical analysis of the buyer's running gait — appointments include treadmill scanning, joint load mapping, and a BCI session to capture neuromuscular firing patterns. The resulting shoe has a custom midsole geometry, a carbon fiber propulsion plate tuned to the wearer's stride, and an upper knit to their exact foot volume. Performance at a level that corponation mass-market shoes can't touch.

Worn by serious Tier 4-5 athletes who compete in amateur circuits, executives who treat their morning run as a competitive event, and anyone who can justify the price as an investment in their body.
functionality: Gait-optimized propulsion. Reduces injury risk through custom joint load distribution. BCI-linked real-time performance feedback optional.
what_it_says: You take your body as seriously as your career. You had your gait analyzed and you paid someone to fix it.
story_hooks: Perihelion's gait database was subpoenaed in a murder case — the biomechanical profile of the suspect's stride matches security footage perfectly.
A Perihelion shoe built for someone with a specific leg augmentation has been ordered under a false name. The biomechanical specs don't match any registered aug configuration.
